biotools.summary: Freeia is a tool that uses robust algorithms to find optimal metabolic factories, which are systems of reactions that produce target molecules from source compounds while conserving or not depleting intermediate metabolites. It addresses limitations in existing shortest factory solvers and provides a complete characterization of the graph-theoretic structure of shortest factories.
